categories_space_system_key_uq.name: categories_space_system_key_uq
categories_space_system_key_uq.where: "categories"."system_key" is not null and "categories"."deleted_at" is null

recurrences_rule_check.name: recurrences_rule_check
recurrences_rule_check.value: "recurrences"."day_rule" is not null or "recurrences"."parts" is not null or "recurrences"."frequency" = 'weekly'

notification_settings_quiet_check.name: notification_settings_quiet_check
notification_settings_quiet_check.value: ("notification_settings"."quiet_start" is null or "notification_settings"."quiet_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') and ("notification_settings"."quiet_end" is null or "notification_settings"."quiet_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
